title: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29): New “Recent Record” virtual table (2000000174)
summary: Business Central 2026 wave 2 introduces the "Recent Record" virtual table (2000000174) that tracks records most recently accessed by the current user within the current company. This read-only table supports deletion but not insert or modify operations, and developers can now retrieve recent records directly from AL code.
key_points: Virtual table 2000000174 tracks the records most recently accessed by the current user in the current company
The table is implicitly scoped to the active user and company context without exposing them as individual fields
Supports read operations and deletion, but direct insert and modify operations are not allowed
Enables developers to access user activity and recent records programmatically through AL code

quotes.text: Microsoft has introduced a new virtual table in this release: table 2000000174 "Recent Record" to track user activity within Business Central.
quotes.why_it_matters: This is the core announcement of the new feature and its purpose in tracking user behavior.

quotes.text: It tracks the records most recently accessed by the current user within the current company.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the scope and purpose of what data the table stores.
